'''{{PAGENAME}}''' is a food item which restores {{Energy|+|30}} and applies the fast reflexes buff when consumed.  Since the items which can be used to craft {{lc:{{PAGENAME}}}} lack quality levels they can not be improved by using higher quality ingredients. For more information on preparing food see [[cooking]].  {{PAGENAME}} can also be purchased from [[Horadric]] in [[The Dead Horse]].

==Effect==
On use, fish will apply the fast reflexes buff for a duration of 2 minutes. Giving the player additional time to hook a fish during fishing. For a list of all buffs see the [[Effects]] page.
